key_insight: Detonation-spraying parameters can tune the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium-dioxide-based metal–ceramic coatings.
engineering_relevance: The reported relationships could guide process settings for maximizing coating hydrophobicity and predicting surface characteristics.
method: Assess coating roughness, thickness, and contact angle.
Derive relationships linking surface properties to nozzle speed and spray distance.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse-power relationships between nozzle travel speed and both roughness and thickness, plus parabolic relationships linking spray distance to roughness and contact angle.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical optimum settings, experimental ranges, or prediction errors, limiting direct process implementation.
paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
